title: Card GMNotes payload (draft-duel)
description: JSON the builder writes into each card's GMNotes and the Global script reads with cardInfo(). Cube and basic-land cards carry id/cmc/land/basic; tokens carry only token, which keeps them out of the deck editor.

id.description: Scryfall id (basic lands: the land's name).

token.description: Token label, a key of TOKENS_JSON.tokens.
